== Source-backed state — Story 611 ==
The 2018 E-marked face ([[:File:ANH-L-grapplinghook-E-2018-07-08.gif]]) has no printed grabber glyph. The later face ([[:File:ANH-L-grapplinghook.gif]]) prints the glyph in its type bar and begins its game text “If opponent just played an Interrupt”. Appendix A p. 114 separately grants the grabber icon; its instruction “This card has the grabber icon” is an attribute update, not a sentence printed in that later game-text box. Printed icon inventories and literal text now follow their selected faces; the later rules grant remains documented here and in the comparison. Existing card identifiers are unchanged.
